item.title: The Question of Meaning as a Path to Transformation. Part 1
item.description: The article contributes to the discussion about the role of the question of meaning in education. item.title: Pedagogical Translanguaging as a Bridge of Return
item.description: The growing return of Polish citizens from Western European countries, increased by Brexit and steady economic growth in Poland, has, for some years, been transforming the demographic and linguistic condition of Polish schools. item.title: The Influence of Value Orientation on the Level of Teacher Burnout
item.description: The article highlights the influence of teachers’ values and personal beliefs on their resilience to burnout syndrome. item.title: Churches as School Learning Spaces – Perspectives on Didactics of Sacred Spaces
item.description: The didactics of sacred spaces is an integrative approach within school-based religious education. It emphasizes churches as didactic learning environments that connect cognitive understanding with sensory and performative engagement. item.title: Theoretical Applications of Modern Apologetics
item.description: The theological field of Christian apologetics has a long and storied history. Due in part to that history and recent interpretations and applications, the field has become detailed and complex to the point that many cannot understand or apply apologetics in the world today effectively. item.title: Integral Human Development in the Educational Vision of Pope Francis
item.description: This article engages the distinctive educational vision of Pope Francis, placing it within the broader theological and philosophical framework of integral human development. item.title: The Teacher as an Authority
item.description: This study analyses two models of authority in the perspective of philosophy of education – one associated with the Herculean myth and its romantic re-reading, and the other with Latour’s interpretation of Gregor Samsa concerning teaching. The study analyses two models of authority and attempts to point out a particular crisis in the understanding of authority in the context of critical perceptions of modernity.

item.title: The Pursuit of Truth and Education
item.description: Describing part of teaching that Cicero dedicated to his son Marcus, and analysing nature and culture as two cooperative hands, the text explains love of wisdom as the reason for publishing the journal Theology and Philosophy of Education.
